subject.title: feat(gateway): allow explicit operator.admin in device auto-approval with critical audit finding

question: Should OpenClaw support an explicit trusted-proxy configuration that automatically grants `operator.admin` to every eligible new browser device?
rationale: This is a deliberate change to the privileged authorization boundary, not a mechanical bug fix; the warning and audit finding cannot decide whether the supported policy is acceptable.

options.title: Retain manual admin approval
options.body: Keep `operator.admin` invalid for device auto-approval so privileged grants always require an explicit approving operator.

options.title: Allow the explicit opt-in
options.body: Accept this configuration only if maintainers endorse the trusted-proxy security model and the PR supplies end-to-end redacted runtime evidence.

recommendation.title: Retain manual admin approval
recommendation.body: Keep `operator.admin` invalid for device auto-approval so privileged grants always require an explicit approving operator.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied related design context and this branch both place this trusted-proxy configuration decision in the shared-gateway direction associated with this contributor.
